title: Russia uses one tactical nuclear weapon in Ukraine, and the days that follow

strikes.launch_name: Russian Iskander-M brigade, Belgorod region (location simulated)
strikes.target_name: Ukrainian reserve staging area, open farmland, eastern Kharkiv region (location simulated)
strikes.notes: Day 1, 09:20 Kyiv. Carrier: Iskander-M, range 400 to 500 km, the dual-capable missile Russia fires conventionally every week (research A14, A30). Yield 15 kt is a simulation choice: no open source gives Russian tactical yields (A16); chosen to equal Hiroshima, about 15 kt (A22, B1). Airburst. Target is a military assembly area in open country, away from cities and from Zaporizhzhia plant (A27).

model: Glasstone and Dolan scaling calibrated to NUKEMAP Hiroshima figures; flight times fitted to published ranges; all values are estimates for a labelled simulation.
